rules.name: xoga713-var-accounting-diagnose
rules.sql: SELECT 'valuation_date_table' AS source, value_date, settlement_date, NULL AS row_count FROM dbsystemuat.valuation_date_table UNION ALL SELECT 'accounting_report_cfs', min(value_date), max(settlement_date), count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_accounting_report_cfs UNION ALL SELECT 'accounting_report_grn', min(value_date), max(settlement_date), count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_accounting_report_grn UNION ALL SELECT 'var_accounting_table_cfs', min(value_date), max(value_date), count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.var_accounting_table_cfs UNION ALL SELECT 'var_accounting_table_grn', min(value_date), max(value_date), count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.var_accounting_table_grn

SELECT 'valuation_date_table ' || upper(business_unit) AS source, value_date, settlement_date, NULL::bigint AS row_count FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) IN ('CFS', 'GRN') UNION ALL SELECT 'var_accounting_table ' || upper(business_unit), min(value_date), max(value_date), count(*) FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(business_unit) IN ('CFS', 'GRN') GROUP BY upper(business_unit) UNION ALL SELECT 'accounting_view ' || upper(business_unit), min(value_date), max(settlement_date), count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE upper(business_unit) IN ('CFS', 'GRN') GROUP BY upper(business_unit)

SELECT s.bu, s.stage, s.row_count FROM ( SELECT 'CFS' AS bu, '1 var_accounting_table' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'CFS', '2 future view', count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_future_view WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'CFS', '3 vanilla view', count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_vanilla_view WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'CFS', '4 future rows with an underlying_list_table match', count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_future_view f JOIN opera.underlying_list_table u ON u.underlying_id = f.p1_name WHERE upper(f.business_unit) = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'CFS', '5 vanilla rows with a vol_id_table match', count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_vanilla_view v JOIN opera.vol_id_table vi ON vi.vol_id = v.vol_id WHERE upper(v.business_unit) = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'CFS', '6 accounting view', count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' UNION ALL SELECT 'GRN', '1 var_accounting_table', count(*) FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'GRN' UNION ALL SELECT 'GRN', '2 future view', count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_future_view WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'GRN' UNION ALL SELECT 'GRN', '3 vanilla view', count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_vanilla_view WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'GRN' UNION ALL SELECT 'GRN', '4 future rows with an underlying_list_table match', count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_future_view f JOIN opera.underlying_list_table u ON u.underlying_id = f.p1_name WHERE upper(f.business_unit) = 'GRN' UNION ALL SELECT 'GRN', '5 vanilla rows with a vol_id_table match', count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_vanilla_view v JOIN opera.vol_id_table vi ON vi.vol_id = v.vol_id WHERE upper(v.business_unit) = 'GRN' UNION ALL SELECT 'GRN', '6 accounting view', count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'GRN' ) s ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, derivative_type, strike, coalesce(vol_id, '') AS vol_id, delta, gamma, theta, vega, delta1, gamma1, vega1, invenio_product_code, future_continuation_series, option_continuation_series FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_accounting_report_cfs

SELECT subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, derivative_type, strike::double precision AS strike, coalesce(vol_id, '') AS vol_id, delta, gamma, theta, vega, delta1, gamma1, vega1, invenio_product_code, future_continuation_series, option_continuation_series FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE lower(business_unit) = 'cfs'

expect.reason: without the dates, cfs rows match legacy by product, contract month, type and strike
